race.comment: ANY QUESTIONS (1) is on resumption today having made the move across from NSW. May need a touch of luck from the barrier but he comes across with good ratings and if he can run up to that level in his new surroundings, he'll be hard to hold out. TANGO RHYTHM (7) was solid on resumption over 1000m at this track when beaten 0.2L. Fitter for that run and getting out in distance now is a big tick for her chances. Can play a leading role. COSTA STAR (6) was never really in the hunt last time, drifting back early and winding up 9 lengths from the winner in seventh over 1406m at Roebourne. Can play a significant role. PLACID ROM (4) stepped out on his debut over 1200m at this track six weeks ago and finished fourth, beaten 4 lengths. Worth following up. RHAENYA (9) was sound on debut and he can play a leading role with that under his belt.
